title: eludite.debug.exception_settings input
description: The Exception Settings window's Common Language Runtime Exceptions: break when an exception is thrown (first chance), or only when user code does not handle it (Visual Studio's default), for every exception or for exception types by name (`types`). Persisted per solution and applied to a running session at once. Types go to the debug adapter as exception filter conditions (DAP exceptionFilterOptions: the comma-separated type names of each filter); while a session runs on an adapter without them, a change of `types` is refused naming the adapter (`capabilities.exception_filter_options` in eludite.debug.state). A category box that is on breaks for every type; its types matter while it is off.

break_when_thrown.description: Break when any exception is thrown (the category's Thrown box).

break_when_user_unhandled.description: Break when user code does not handle any exception (the category's User-Unhandled box).

types.description: Add or change exception types under the category: each entry replaces that type's row.

break_when_thrown.description: Break when this type (or a subclass, as the adapter matches it) is thrown. Default true.

break_when_user_unhandled.description: Break when user code does not handle this type. Default true.

clear.description: Remove every type's row (before `types` is applied).
